highlights.text: Eliminated from the captaincy task alongside ScoutOP.
Partnered with Aasif Khan to perform a hilarious South Indian dub movie dialogue parody.
Was trolled alongside his gang by Gullu.
Engaged in an ugly washroom confrontation with Kanika Mann over respect and inappropriate remarks.
Emerged as a fan favourite online due to his witty comebacks.
Faced criticism from Kanika Mann regarding his leadership skills in the house.
Became the first captain of Bigg Boss Season 20.
Involved in a major row with Kanika Mann over male washroom access and duty assignments.
Won the captaincy task to become the very first captain of Bigg Boss 20.
Was called 'childish' by Kushal Tanwar (Gullu) following his captaincy win.
Competed for the house's first captaincy against Aasif Khan and Kushal Tanwar.
Remembered Bigg Boss 13 winner Sidharth Shukla during a conversation in the house.
Engaged in an intense heated clash with Qazi Touqeer during the first captaincy task.
The Pune rapper entered the house and had a heated exchange with Qazi Touqeer.
Rapper engaged in a lighthearted banter with Salman Khan after sharing he is from Yerwada.
